registryEvidence.custodian: Katsina State Geographic Information Service (KATGIS) and Katsina State Ministry of Lands & Survey.

The Ministry site provides state registration information and land-law/fee material. This establishes state-level custody relevant to Daura, not verified citywide parcel geometry coverage.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No safe anonymous parcel ID+geometry response, native field, CRS, or public vector layer was verified. The unchanged WUP point was not used as a parcel hit/miss test.

technicalBlocker: Current first-party KATGIS pages are service/verification/registration workflows. Anonymous GETs and review of the current Next.js page scripts found no public parcel map, ArcGIS/GeoServer/vector endpoint, schema, CRS or safe ID+geometry response. MOLS registration is an application form and its public WordPress API is content metadata, not a parcel service.
remainingUncertainty: Whether KATGIS maintains a separate authorized public map or service endpoint, its native parcel identity and CRS, and whether any such service covers Daura. A zero public response here is not evidence of citywide absence.
nextStep: Revisit only if an official public viewer configuration or vector service is documented; qualify metadata and a bounded safe ID+geometry response before runtime admission.
